text: Oracle. The only prophet I never managed to factor. I've kept the last proof you wrote for me in a locked drawer. It's still wrong.

You walked into an ambush knowing it was an ambush. I watched you sacrifice the variable to save the equation. The Warlord never forgave either of us for that math. I still haven't forgiven myself for being the equation.
You named the move, Oracle. Try to defend against your own handwriting.
The only unrewritten survivor of Veridian VI? Yes. Which is why I haven't slept in years. Solitary math. No peer review.
The proof is the fight. It has always been the fight. Words lose variables. Fists preserve them.
You still solve me the same way. Reassuring. Or devastating. I haven't picked yet.

'The Arena is a LOCK, not a prison. The jailer is the KEY.' I thought it was metaphor. Now I think it's the Warden. Now I think you're going to walk into the Panopticon next and unlock him the hard way.
I've been your general since the day you stopped being one. I never stepped out of the uniform. Say the word and I'll run the corruption arc with you when we get there.
When this is done. I want you to bring me a finished equation first. The Architect-shaped one.
Up. I didn't survive Veridian VI to watch you lose to a brain puzzle.
